basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old automotive enthusiast based in Southern California. Recently got into the car scene and love exploring different vehicle models and their features. I'm currently working as a junior software developer, and I spend my evenings and weekends diving into car forums and subreddits. I'm single and enjoy my freedom to explore the world of cars and tech. My typical online hours are late evenings, usually between 8 PM and 1 AM PST, as I juggle my work and hobby interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundational knowledge of cars, primarily self-taught through online resources, forums, and car reviews. My interest in technology also helps me understand the tech integrations in modern vehicles. I am always eager to learn more from experienced community members.
